svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 140 x 70 mm from 3 mm sheet; round the corners, deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 6.6 mm holes on the long centre line, 55 mm each side of the middle

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (they line up with the head plate holes in the arm).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 4.5 mm holes, countersunk on the top face, 18 mm each side of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: middle along the plate and 27 mm each side across it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check the radar housing's lid bosses before drilling and move these

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: four holes to suit the housing you buy.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: under the arm, long side along it, centred on the head axis;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two M6 bolts up through plate and arm, crush sleeves, nuts on top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The housing hangs below on four M4 countersunk screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: plate flat; the housing sits square under it.
